step1_verification.description: R04E17's own e17_div_f3_t68p61.cir re-run unmodified except one added .meas line (IL1_AT_TSTOP FIND I(L1) AT 368.61u). The re-run's own .log did not print .meas results (a benign LTspice/wine post-processing hiccup after an 'unable to open database file' message), so all values were independently extracted directly from the .raw binary trace using the same FIND-AT/MAX/MIN semantics LTspice itself uses, then cross-checked against R04E17's own already-committed results.json.
step1_verification.note: IL1_AT_TSTOP is not in R04E17's own published .meas set (only IL1_MIN/IL1_MAX envelope); this is the new value this Step-1 re-run was built to obtain.

step2_initial_conditions_used.phases_2_4_gate_config: R04E3's own hardcoded single-phase-isolation config, unchanged (BOUNDARY.md Section 4)

outcome_classification.reasoning: STATE_FINAL=4 (COMMUTATE_HIGH_TO_ZVS) at TSTOP=20us, identical to R04E3's own documented stuck state. T_HIGH_SIDE_ZVS (the state-4-to-5 transition on V(vin,xmod:a1)<=0) FAILED to occur. The bootstrapped state reached this same stall point in ~1.69us (much faster than zero-start, since IL1_IC already exceeded I_LIMIT at t=0), but the SAME event (high-side Vds=0) never occurred, so the controller parks in the same place R04E3 always parks.
